plugins.name: rv-park-screen
plugins.description: RV Park Screen — screen ONE park from an ADDRESS, no numbers required. Pulls what is knowable for free (satellite image first, RV-vs-MHP class from the EPA water registry, pad-count proxy, parcel, FEMA flood zone, wildfire hazard, area crime, owner of record where public), then hands back the call sheet: exactly what to ask the seller or broker and why each answer matters. Free sources only — anything unavailable is marked NOT FOUND, never guessed. Emits a readable packet and a structured record. A single property is always a screen; a county or market is rv-park-scan; running the numbers is rv-park-quick-underwrite. Operator-agnostic — the destination resolves per owner and emits nothing by default. Directional only — not financial advice.
